visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with braided hair and a sun hat sits next to a man in a gray sun-protection shirt inside a bright red and blue inflatable tunnel. They smile broadly and wave toward the camera. (2) A high-angle drone shot reveals a massive outdoor water park set on a green field. It features multiple colorful inflatable slides, blue pools, and rows of yellow umbrellas. (3) A young boy in purple trunks slides down a multi-lane blue slide into a pool. The scene shifts to children splashing in a blue pool with a large pink octopus inflatable structure in the background. (4) A woman climbs a large blue and white inflatable dome while children play nearby. A man in a black hat and gray shirt is seen sliding down a very tall, steep purple and blue inflatable slide, looking excited with his arms raised. (5) Children play in a colorful ball pit filled with yellow, red, blue, and green plastic balls. A man helps a child in a small blue boat in a shallow pool area. Staff in yellow shirts are seen interacting with children using water guns. (6) A close-up shows a person in plastic gloves preparing shaved ice, pouring red, green, and blue syrups over the white ice. (7) The woman and two children stand before a large pink flamingo-themed inflatable arch, waving and gesturing energetically with high-vibe expressions.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female host, 1 male host, 2 main kids, and at least 14 other children and staff visible throughout the water park shots.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with long black braids wearing a floral long-sleeved swimwear and a straw sun hat; a man in a gray athletic sun-protection shirt and a black bucket hat.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An expansive outdoor temporary water park with various large inflatable slides, pools, green artificial turf, yellow sun umbrellas, and city buildings in the distant background under a clear sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal greeting delivered with a sharp rising pitch contour and fast speech rate. An upbeat electronic pop background music track with a driving 4/4 beat and bright synth textures starts immediately. (2) A transition whoosh sound effect marks a shift as the male narrator describes the water park's location. The BGM remains consistent in tempo, maintaining a high-arousal atmosphere while soft splashes of water and distant children's laughter are mixed into the background. (3) A series of quick 'pop' sound effects synchronize with visual text appearances as the narrator lists different facilities. The vocal delivery is enunciated and clear, exhibiting a professional yet excited tone with high spectral brightness. (4) A distinctive mechanical scraping sound is heard for two seconds, representing a shaved ice machine, layered over the continuous BGM. This is followed by a splashing 'impact' sound effect as the narrator mentions the water gun battle. (5) The female host joins the male narrator in a final group shout; their voices exhibit high volume intensity and joyful valence. The BGM swells slightly before fading out with a clean hard cut at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Introduction -> Value Proposition -> Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Wabo Wabo Water Fest' in Taoyuan as a must-visit summer family destination. The video uses high-energy visuals of water slides and activities, combined with enthusiastic narration and specific 'limited time' calls-to-action, to encourage viewership engagement and attendance.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names 'Wabo Wabo Summer Water Festival', provides its location, operating dates, and ends with a lucky draw ticket giveaway.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video's highly fragmented editing and high-arousal audio make it typical of social media promotional content aimed at families and youth.
